title: Smart routing: legal eligibility before price optimisation
summary: The VMM smart router chooses among independently attributable venue/access routes only after exact-line, market/compliance, capital, locate and capacity checks; then it ranks fee/rebate-adjusted executable economics.
invariants: Tradable inventory identity is exact legal line: ISIN + venue/listing MIC + relevant currencies.
Economic equivalence or fungibility is a separate evidence relationship and never silently changes inventory identity.
A sanctions/custody/transfer event may impair or break an equivalence link without moving historical inventory.
New short exposure requires valid locate capacity before route admission.
Federation does not choose or invoke VMM venue adapters.

provenance.claim: Smart-route admission order, fee/rebate economics, route isolation, locate, market restrictions and VMM capital policy.
